language.description: Language for syntax highlighting (e.g. `html`, `js`, `css`). Falls back to a `language` on the inner `<code>`, then to none — an unset language renders plain, uncoloured text.

scrollable.description: When `"true"`, the block scrolls horizontally instead of wrapping. Long lines keep their shape rather than reflowing.

show-line-numbers.description: Line numbers in a gutter beside the code. On unless set to `"false"`.
show-line-numbers.default: this is the show line numbers

max-height.description: A CSS length capping the rendered height (e.g. `20rem`). Past it the block scrolls vertically instead of growing the page.

wrap.description: Wrap long lines instead of overflowing. Off unless set; `wrap="false"` is honoured as off.

size.description: Type scale for the code text: `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Defaults to `md`.

show-copy.description: Show a copy-to-clipboard button in the corner of the block.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
